description: Temporary exemptions for pre-existing auth-schema writes outside auth-service. New DML against auth.users or auth.refresh_tokens must not be added outside the owning auth-service.

exemptions.reason: Legacy public reset-password endpoint still mutates auth.users until delegated to auth-service reset flow.
Legacy public reset-password endpoint still revokes refresh tokens until delegated to auth-service reset flow.
Legacy tenant rollback/deprovision path still removes bootstrap tenant admins until tenant provisioning is fully delegated to auth-service.
Legacy tenant deprovision path still deactivates users until tenant provisioning is fully delegated to auth-service.
Legacy first-admin bootstrap still creates auth.users directly until tenant provisioning is fully delegated to auth-service.
